experience.summary: Led backend architecture for an enterprise workflow platform using Java, Spring Boot, and Oracle; delivered configurable approvals, versioned forms, and real-time collaboration for multi-team operations.
qualitativeAssessment: Applied Aspect-Oriented Programming to modularise cross-cutting concerns, reduce duplication, and improve maintainability across the platform.
Owned the detection and remediation of image vulnerabilities to support more secure and stable deployments.
Participated in production deployments and database migrations using Datical, supporting smooth CI/CD integration.
Applied caching strategies, Splunk-based JSON logging, XML parsing, robust error handling, clean-code practices, and unit testing across projects.

recommendations.name: Sagar Kharade
recommendations.comment: Aditya is a dedicated Java developer with strong fundamentals and a good understanding of backend and front-end development. He picks up concepts quickly, writes clean code, and consistently delivers reliable solutions. A dependable team member with a positive attitude. He is proactive in learning, asks the right questions. and applies feedback effectively.

recommendations.name: Selvabharathi Suriyan
recommendations.comment: I had the pleasure of working with Aditya. a highly talented full-stack developer who manages applications end-to-end with great expertise. He is consistently responsive, delivers high-quality solutions, and brings valuable ideas that improve implementation efficiency. His ability to handle both front-end and back-end challenges makes him an essential team player. I highly recommend him for any development project requiring skill, creativity, and reliability.

details.text: Architected the streaming validation and batched JDBC persistence pipeline to ingest
details.suffix: —bypassing row-by-row ORM overhead with a modular design carried through to production by the team.

details.text: Dynamic DB-Driven State Machine: Replaced static in-memory/BPMN workflow patterns with a table-driven state engine, cutting workflow rule rollout time by
details.suffix: (from multi-week code-and-redeploy cycles to API configuration updates) and saving ~150+ engineering/release hours across multiple policy evolutions.

details.text: Automated Lock Lifecycle Management: Engineered deterministic lock acquisition and timeout-release semantics, reducing orphaned session deadlocks and manual administrative unlock interventions by
details.suffix: and reclaiming ~150+ specialist & developer hours/year previously lost to multi-day review stalls.

details.text: Real-Time WebSocket State Sync: Replaced manual refreshes and avoided periodic HTTP polling with event-driven WebSocket state broadcasting, slashing redundant status-check database queries by
details.suffix: and achieving sub-second state convergence across concurrent reviewers.

details.text: Schema-Agnostic JSON Diffing Audit Engine: Built an AOP-backed JSON delta tracker that automatically records field-level change histories across evolving form schemas—saving
details.suffix: in audit-table migrations, cutting audit storage growth by ~75% vs. full row snapshots, and eliminating external licensing costs.

details.text: Native Recursive Threaded Comments: Shipped an in-context nested comment and resolution system using single-query
details.suffix: and recursive Angular components, avoiding recurring third-party UI SDK costs (100% on-prem data residency) and eliminating fragmented email/chat review loops.
